system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

You are not someone who gives in easily. You have created a short saying to yourself, something you repeat to yourself when you are in a tight spot and when your backs against the wall. This saying is your Nindo, your Ninja way, and you repeat it when things get tough. You select one Nindo phrase reflavoring it to fit your shinobi, gaining its effects. You expand your horizons at 7th and 15th level, being inspired by your mentors, allies and clients, gaining an additional Nindo, at the select levels.

Never Back Down

This Nindo is one of tenacity. When an you gain a Physical or Mental Condition, you did not have ranks of already from a hostile effect, you gain 1 Drive. If you spend 1 Drive on your turn, you gain advantage on the first attack roll and saving throw you make before the beginning of your next turn.

Never Give up

This Nindo is one of perseverance. When you Clash with a hostile creature, you gain 2 Drive and a rank of Mastery to this Clash check.

Additionally, once per long rest, when you roll a Death saving throw, you can spend 2 Drive as part of rolling a success, you treat it as if you had succeeded twice.

Never Abandon A Friend

This Nindo is one of compassion. When an allied creature that you can reach within half of your movement speed takes damage, you can spend your reaction and 2 Drive to move up to half your speed towards them, redirect the damage to yourself, and if possible cast a Jutsu with a casting time of Reaction, when you take damage as part of this reaction.

Additionally, if an allied creature is Dying and you attempt to stabilize them, you make the check at advantage. On a success, they regain hit points equal to your level. You can heal a dying creature in this way once per long rest, per creature.

Never lose a Fight

This Nindo is one of power. When you lose a clash with a hostile creature, you can choose to spend 2 Drive. When you do, you treat this clash as if it were a draw.

Additionally, when you roll initiative fighting a hostile creature whose level is 2 or higher than your own, you gain 2 Will of Fire. If you have not used these Will of Fire before the end of combat, you lose them.

Never Fail

This Nindo is one of resilience. Once per turn, when you fail a saving throw that would deal damage to you, you can spend 2 Drive to remake the failed saving throw. If you spend 5 Drive, you can instead choose to automatically succeed, suffering no damage or effects that would be applied on a success.

Never Give In

This Nindo is one of resolve. When an ally is reduced to 0 hit points that you can see, you can spend 3 Drive. When you do, at the end of your next turn, you immediately take an additional turn. You gain 3 ranks of Exhaustion at the end of that additional turn.

Always Finish What I Start

This Nindo is one of conviction. Once per turn, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain 2 Drive, even if you gained Drive already this turn and can move up to half your speed towards another hostile creature. If you end this movement with that creature within your weapons range, you can make one weapon attack targeting them, dealing 2d6 bonus damage on a hit.

Always Move First

This Nindo is one of preparation. When you roll initiative, mark each hostile creature whose result is lower than yours until the end of your next turn. The first time you deal damage to a marked creature as a result of an attack, you can treat the attack as a critical hit, causing the creature to lose their mark.

Always Protect What Matters

This Nindo is one of purpose. When an allied creature within 30 feet is hit by a critical attack or fails a saving throw, you can spend your reaction to cast a D-Rank jutsu with a casting time of 1 Action, targeting the assailing creature, forcing a Clash.

Always Save Who I can

This Nindo is one of healing. When you cast a Jutsu or use a feature that restores an allied creatures, excluding yourself, hit points, you can spend 2 Drive to mark them as Saved, for the next minute. A Saved creature that gains ranks of a condition from a hostile effect, reduced the ranks they would gain by 1, losing the Saved mark.

Always Fix What is Broken

This Nindo is one of restoration. When you cast a jutsu or use a feature that removed a Condition from an allied creature you can spend 2 Drive to mark them as Fixed for the next minute. A Fixed creature is treated as they have resistance to the condition originally removed by you.

Always Go Beyond

This Nindo is one of evolution. The first time you fall below half your maximum hit or chakra points, you can choose to enter your Ultra Focus state. Once you enter this state, you cannot re-enter it until you complete a short rest.

| #### Ultra Focus / Fortitude Amp / Your back is against the wall and you need to focus, going beyond what your limits suggest; / Uncapped Strength. You gain a +2 bonus to damage you deal. This increases to +4 at 11th level. / Broken Limits. Once per turn on your turn, you can spend 3 Drive, spending your Bonus Action, to gain an Action. / Always Push Forward. You gain advantage on saving throws and checks to resist being Grappled, Restrained, Stunned, Staggered having your speed reduced by hostile effects. / Stress. At the end of each of your turns, make a Constitution ability check vs a DC 20. On a success, you persist in this state and it doesn’t end. On a failure, this state ends. |
